one_sentence_story: A single amber evidence trace leaves a source artifact, passes through a transparent Context Capsule, becomes a six-sided cusp fibre, persists as a linked torus family, and closes as a testable S6 paper claim beside a separate world-trace receipt.

beats.causal_move: The source artifact emits one trace.
beats.visual: A warm paper sheet stands on a dark basalt tile at left; one amber filament exits its lower edge and travels right.
beats.audio: A dry paper click, then one low pulse as the filament starts.

beats.causal_move: The trace enters the transparent Context Capsule.
beats.visual: The filament passes through a glass capsule at center; the capsule reveals a quiet inner frame without adding dashboard panels.
beats.audio: The pulse acquires a clean glass resonance; no new voiceover claim is introduced.

beats.causal_move: The capsule compresses the trace into a cusp hexagonal fibre.
beats.visual: At the capsule exit, the amber line pinches once into a luminous six-sided cusp; the original line remains visibly attached.
beats.audio: A single tightening tone marks the one geometric change.

beats.causal_move: The cusp fibre unfolds into a persistent torus family.
beats.visual: The six-sided fibre opens into three linked torus rings along the same path; the source filament remains the spine through every ring.
beats.audio: Three evenly spaced tones establish family membership without implying proof.

beats.causal_move: The trace is paired with a receipt slot and a framed paper claim.
beats.visual: The torus family settles beside a white receipt strip and a restrained title card: PAPER CLAIM / TESTABLE; the receipt strip is a world-trace slot, not invented data.
beats.audio: The music resolves only after the receipt/world-trace marker appears; the narrator says the claim remains open to falsification.

caption_script: A trace can keep its identity while its form changes. This film follows one source artifact through context, cusp fibre, and a torus family. The S6 paper claim is shown as a paper claim, not consensus fact: it closes only beside a world-trace receipt and remains falsifiable.

manim_plan.render_contract: Deterministic Manim scene, 16:9 landscape, fixed camera, no random seeds, no external image or generated evidence.
manim_plan.coordinate_system: Use x in [-8.4, 8.4] and y in [-4.7, 4.7]; keep source at (-5.7, -0.2), capsule at (0, 0), and claim card at (5.2, 2.7).
construction_order: Create basalt tiles, source artifact, and three short readable labels.
Draw one ParametricFunction for amber_trace from source to capsule; animate Create once.
Create the capsule as a Rectangle with fill_opacity=0.06 and stroke_opacity=0.75; reveal its inner frame.
Replace only the local trace segment at the capsule exit with a six-vertex Polygon; preserve both endpoints.
Build three Torus objects with fixed radii (1.05, 0.34), fixed rotations, and one continuous glowing path.
Add a blank receipt strip labelled WORLD TRACE / RECEIPT SLOT and a separate card labelled PAPER CLAIM / TESTABLE.
Hold the full composition for 2 seconds; keep all causal objects visible.
manim_plan.accessibility: All semantic labels are short, high-contrast, and rendered as real text; no pseudo-text texture is used.

falsifier: The visual claim is refuted for this concept if the trace cannot be matched continuously from source artifact to torus family, if the world-trace receipt cannot be supplied independently, or if the paper claim is presented as established fact rather than a testable claim.
truth_boundary: The reference image supplies visual grammar only. This candidate supplies a deterministic reconstruction plan; it does not assert a paper result or invent a world event.
